text: When a payment is slow or stuck, how would anyone know?
prefix: When a payment is slow or stuck, how would anyone know?

text: One payment crosses the app, an adapter and a scheme, and the logs on each machine can't follow it.
prefix: One payment crosses the app, an adapter and a scheme, and the logs on each machine can't follow it.

text: So the app and both adapters import one platform library, observability, and adding the jar is all a service does.
prefix: So the app and both adapters import one platform library, observability, and adding the jar is all a service does.

text: It traces every request with Micrometer Tracing and OpenTelemetry, and carries the trace on every call: to the adapters, through Kafka, and into Temporal.
prefix: It traces every request with Micrometer Tracing and OpenTelemetry, and carries the trace on every call: to the adapters, through Kafka, and into Temporal.

text: One trace follows a payment from the payment page, through the app's modules, into the Uzcard adapter and out to the scheme.
prefix: One trace follows a payment from the payment page, through the app's modules, into the Uzcard adapter and out to the scheme.

text: Every response names its trace in an X-Request-Id header, a 401 or 403 too, so a caller can quote it to support.
prefix: Every response names its trace in an X-Request-Id header, a 401 or 403 too, so a caller can quote it to support.

text: The logs carry the same trace id, so a warning links straight to the trace it belongs to.
prefix: The logs carry the same trace id, so a warning links straight to the trace it belongs to.

text: Every log line is masked on every sink, every outgoing call too: card numbers keep their first six and last four digits, tokens their last four, and secrets are hidden.
prefix: Every log line is masked on every sink, every outgoing call too: card numbers keep their first six and last four digits, tokens their last four, and secrets are hidden.

text: Spring Boot exports JVM, HTTP and database pool metrics, and the app adds only what Boot can't know: how payments end.
prefix: Spring Boot exports JVM, HTTP and database pool metrics, and the app adds only what Boot can't know: how payments end.

text: Every debit is counted by card scheme and outcome: approved, declined, unknown, or failed before any money moved.
prefix: Every debit is counted by card scheme and outcome: approved, declined, unknown, or failed before any money moved.

text: And the scheme's answer time is measured, with fixed buckets that reach past its forty second limit.
prefix: And the scheme's answer time is measured, with fixed buckets that reach past its forty second limit.

text: Health indicators check the file store, Vault, Keycloak and both adapters, and each one is also a gauge: one while it is up.
prefix: Health indicators check the file store, Vault, Keycloak and both adapters, and each one is also a gauge: one while it is up.

text: Everything goes over OTLP to one stack: Prometheus for metrics, Tempo for traces, Loki for logs, and Grafana on top.
prefix: Everything goes over OTLP to one stack: Prometheus for metrics, Tempo for traces, Loki for logs, and Grafana on top.

text: The payments dashboard puts it together: debits by outcome, unknown debits in red, answer times, errors per service, and pool waits.
prefix: The payments dashboard puts it together: debits by outcome, unknown debits in red, answer times, errors per service, and pool waits.

text: Grafana's alert rules live as code in the infrastructure repository, and every alert is an email to the on-call list, Mailpit locally.
prefix: Grafana's alert rules live as code in the infrastructure repository, and every alert is an email to the on-call list, Mailpit locally.

text: When the scheme goes silent, the debit shows up as unknown, the adapter's client error fires an alert email, and the warning links to its trace.
prefix: When the scheme goes silent, the debit shows up as unknown, the adapter's client error fires an alert email, and the warning links to its trace.

text: Next, what to do when the processing center goes completely silent.
prefix: Next, what to do when the processing center goes completely silent.
